article.title: Why Organize Semiconductor Workers? w/ CHIPS Communities United
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: Semiconductors are at the heart of every piece of electronics you interact with on a daily basis. Despite being invented and innovated in the US, much of the manufacturing of semiconductors and the technology they power was “offshored” from the 1980s through the early 2000s as part of the globalization of our economy. In an effort to counter that loss of jobs and industry… Source
